verdict.rationale: Linear's homepage says incoming feedback becomes issues that are automatically routed, labeled and prioritized. Event-triggered Loops and Linear Agent's handling of newly reported issues provide a first-party AI mechanism that could do this triage. However, the evidence is marketing-level and never documents an AI triage feature that assigns priority to incoming bugs. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on AI-driven triage and priority assignment for new issues, explicit confirmation that the routing/labeling/prioritizing is AI-powered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
When a new issue is reported, Linear Agent can investigate and attempt a fix before it reaches an engineer, reducing the load on your team.
Describe the job in plain language and then choose whether it should run on a schedule or in response to an event.
You can triage, plan, review, and ship—all in Linear.
